en.headline: Hong Kong astronaut leads Tiangong Class for HK and Macau students today
en.dek: Lai Ka-ying and her Shenzhou-23 crewmates will deliver a live space lecture from the Tiangong station starting at 9.50am, with schools encouraged to watch the broadcast.
body: Hong Kong’s first astronaut, Lai Ka-ying, will join her Shenzhou-23 crewmates on Wednesday morning to deliver a live “Tiangong Class” lecture from the Chinese space station to students in Hong Kong and Macau.

According to an Education Bureau notice sent to primary and secondary schools on Tuesday, the 90-minute session begins at 9.50am. Mission commander Zhu Yangzhu, astronaut Zhang Zhiyuan and payload specialist Lai will act as space teachers, providing expert commentary, demonstrating science experiments in orbit and taking part in a live question-and-answer exchange.

The event is jointly organised by the Hong Kong and Macau governments and the China Manned Space Agency. A Macau student and teacher delegation will attend in person at Tsuen Wan Public Ho Chuen Yiu Memorial College, Lai’s former secondary school, while representatives from the youth and innovation sectors will also be present.

The Education Bureau has invited schools to arrange for teachers and students to watch the live broadcast on campus. The session will be carried on the Information Services Department website, the news.gov.hk Facebook page, RTHK and other local television stations.

zh.headline: 天宮課堂港澳專場今早舉行 黎家盈與學生天地對話
zh.dek: 神舟二十三號乘組包括港產航天員黎家盈，將於上午9時50分起為港澳學生進行太空授課及科學實驗示範，教育局鼓勵學校安排師生收看直播。
body: 香港首位航天員黎家盈將於星期三早上聯同神舟二十三號乘組，在天宮空間站為港澳學生主持「天宮課堂·港澳專場」太空授課活動。
教育局星期二向全港中小學發出通函，活動預計上午9時50分開始，歷時約一小時半。指令長朱楊柱、航天員張志遠及載荷專家黎家盈將擔任太空教師，進行專家講解、在軌科學實驗示範，並與學生展開天地互動對話。
活動由香港特區政府、澳門特區政府及中國載人航天工程辦公室共同主辦。澳門師生代表團將到黎家盈母校荃灣公立何傳耀紀念中學現場參與，青年及創科界代表亦會出席。
教育局誠邀各中小學安排師生於校內實時觀看直播。市民亦可透過政府新聞處網站、政府新聞網Facebook專頁、港台及其他本地電視台收看。
